title: From Prose to Properties: Testing Research Claims with ARATest for Agent-Native Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.30495v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents now run experiments and report findings, so research produces claims faster than researchers can check them. Each empirical claim implies a property that must hold over its cases, but it states that property only in prose. Without an explicit property, no test can decide which evidence would falsify a claim, so validation cannot keep pace with the claims agents produce. To make claims testable, we approximate a claim's semantics by abstracting its property skeleton, a parameterized relation that recurs across claims. We present ARATest, a property-based testing library that checks these skeletons as executable tests. A typed declaration binds a claim to a skeleton and fixes the claim's compared quantities, cases, scope, and numerical policy. translated_title: 从文字到属性：面向智能体原生科学、用 ARATest 检验研究论断
translated_abstract: AI 智能体现在能够运行实验并报告发现，因此研究产生论断的速度已经超过了研究者能够核查的速度。每个实证论断都隐含着一个必须在其所有案例上成立的属性，但它只用文字来陈述这一属性。如果没有明确的属性，任何测试都无法判定哪些证据可以证伪一个论断，因此验证无法跟上智能体产生论断的速度。为了使论断可测试，我们通过抽象出论断的“属性骨架”来近似论断的语义——属性骨架是一种在多个论断中反复出现的参数化关系。我们提出了 ARATest，一个基于属性的测试库，它将这些骨架作为可执行测试进行检验。类型化声明将论断绑定到骨架上，并固定该论断所比较的量、案例、范围和数值策略。共享的案例类型使每个生成器都以论断的统计单位提供案例。三值语义为每个属性赋予三种判定结果之一：成立、被违反或不确定。
tldr: 该论文提出 ARATest，一个基于属性的测试库，通过将研究论断抽象为可执行的“属性骨架”并配合类型化声明、共享案例类型和三值判定语义进行自动化检验，使 AI 智能体产生的研究论断变得可测试、可证伪，从而解决验证速度跟不上论断产出速度的问题。
en_tdlr: ARATest is a property-based testing library that makes AI-agent-generated research claims testable by abstracting their semantics into executable property skeletons, using typed declarations, shared case types, and a three-valued verdict semantics (holds, violated, or inconclusive).
